presentation.dropped: on1xc: {count} diagnostics omitted by the registry limit
presentation.invalid_edits: invalid, unordered, overlapping or duplicate edits
presentation.source_limit: repaired source exceeds source byte limit
presentation.compiler_validated: reloaded, parsed, type checked and C-emitted; intended behavior is not proven

diagnostics.guidance: Inspect the reported source; no automatic semantic repair is available.
diagnostics.remediation: Correct the source at the reported location and compile it again.

diagnostics.message: The selected diagnostic catalog is malformed, unavailable, or changed while being read.
diagnostics.guidance: Use a regular, bounded JSON catalog that satisfies the complete versioned schema.
diagnostics.remediation: Correct or replace the selected catalog; the trusted embedded catalog remains active for this error.

diagnostics.message: The selected scrutiny policy, directive, or analysis work budget is invalid.
diagnostics.guidance: Select one scrutiny level declared by the active catalog and a bounded positive work budget.
diagnostics.remediation: Correct the command-line, project, or file-local scrutiny selection.

diagnostics.message: The PPX diagnostic sideband record is malformed, excessive, undeclared, or unregistered.
diagnostics.guidance: A PPX may emit only complete bounded records for cataloged entries that it registered first.
diagnostics.remediation: Correct the PPX sideband implementation or disable the untrusted transformer.

diagnostics.message: Diagnostic detail exceeds the bounded reporting limit.
diagnostics.guidance: The compilation failed; oversized diagnostic detail was not retained.
diagnostics.remediation: Reduce the source construct responsible for the oversized diagnostic and compile again.

diagnostics.guidance: Check the expected token and surrounding delimiters.
diagnostics.remediation: Review a bounded punctuation insertion or replacement before validating it with the compiler.

diagnostics.guidance: Check the type spelling; type changes require review.
diagnostics.remediation: Compare the spelling with an existing primitive type and re-run the complete checker.

diagnostics.guidance: Portable stdffi imports have no unsafe mode.
diagnostics.remediation: Use the portable import syntax for supported exports, or an explicitly supported KernelBind profile.

diagnostics.guidance: A native kernel's availability does not imply a portable implementation.
diagnostics.remediation: Select an executable recipe for a reviewed kernel and check MULIB_FOREIGNLIB_PATH.

diagnostics.guidance: The first matching path must contain an executable recipe that agrees with the compiled review.
diagnostics.remediation: Correct the selected ffispec 1 file or adjust MULIB_FOREIGNLIB_PATH.

diagnostics.guidance: A generated header catalogue records declarations, not executable portable FFI behavior.
diagnostics.remediation: Select a reviewed ffispec 1 recipe instead of the generated catalogue.

diagnostics.guidance: An import binds a namespace; not all native types or functions are portable exports.
diagnostics.remediation: Reference a supported portable function using its local import alias.

diagnostics.guidance: Portable import aliases occupy the module namespace.
diagnostics.remediation: Choose a distinct alias and update its qualified references.

diagnostics.guidance: A source-only import request is not a checked definition.
diagnostics.remediation: Load the source through the compiler's module loader before checking or emitting it.

diagnostics.guidance: The compiler's portable implementation did not meet the internal definition requirements.
diagnostics.remediation: Report the invalid registry definition; the export cannot be used until it is corrected.

diagnostics.guidance: Unit-v1 AST transport cannot represent the compiler's private portable function names.
diagnostics.remediation: Use a checked compilation or MIR product instead of Unit-v1 AST transport.

diagnostics.guidance: Check the inferred types; no coercion or language rule has been changed.
diagnostics.remediation: Make the source types agree explicitly.

diagnostics.guidance: Check the binding and semantic constraints at this location.
diagnostics.remediation: Correct the named binding or violated semantic constraint.

diagnostics.guidance: Check string escapes, comments, and token spelling.
diagnostics.remediation: Replace the invalid byte or token with supported source syntax.

diagnostics.guidance: Source files cannot contain embedded NUL bytes.
diagnostics.remediation: Remove the NUL byte or use a supported data representation.

diagnostics.guidance: Reduce the source size; the compiler limit is unchanged.
diagnostics.remediation: Split or reduce the source without raising the trusted compiler limit.

diagnostics.guidance: Scanner allocation failed; no repair was attempted.
diagnostics.remediation: Retry with sufficient resources or reduce the input size.

diagnostics.message: The analyzed path has a divisor that is definitely zero.
diagnostics.guidance: Wetstone proved that the divisor is zero on the analyzed straight-line HIR path.
diagnostics.remediation: Reject zero before division or establish a nonzero divisor invariant.

diagnostics.message: The analyzed path may have a zero divisor.
diagnostics.guidance: Wetstone could not exclude a zero divisor on the analyzed straight-line HIR path.
diagnostics.remediation: Add and preserve an explicit nonzero guard before division.

diagnostics.message: The analyzed path has an assertion that definitely fails.
diagnostics.guidance: Wetstone proved that this assertion fails on the analyzed straight-line HIR path.
diagnostics.remediation: Correct the asserted invariant or the preceding control and data flow.

diagnostics.message: The analyzed path may have an assertion that fails.
diagnostics.guidance: Wetstone could not prove this assertion on the analyzed straight-line HIR path.
diagnostics.remediation: Strengthen the checked invariant or make the required guard explicit.

diagnostics.message: The ownership model reports a repeated release.
diagnostics.guidance: Wetstone found a repeated release of one modeled SSA resource in a basic block.
diagnostics.remediation: Transfer ownership exactly once or make the release protocol explicitly idempotent.

diagnostics.message: The selected diagnostics PPX emitted its cataloged advisory.
diagnostics.guidance: An explicitly selected PPX emitted this cataloged advisory.
diagnostics.remediation: Review the advisory and its original source location.
